name: LongMemEval
ontology_notes: Chat-assistant eval, not a memory engine. 500 questions inside timestamped user-assistant haystacks. Official question_type values are single-session-user, single-session-assistant, single-session-preference, temporal-reasoning, knowledge-update, and multi-session. question_id ending _abs marks abstention. Released scales are LongMemEval_S (~115k tokens, ~40 sessions) and LongMemEval_M (~500 sessions). Cleaned haystacks are on Hugging Face as xiaowu0162/longmemeval-cleaned (README, 2025-09 note).

supersession.evidence: knowledge-update is an official question_type. Paper lists knowledge updates as one of five core abilities. README Dataset Format.
supersession.label: measured

temporal.evidence: temporal-reasoning question_type. Haystacks carry haystack_dates. Repo also ships time-aware query expansion (src/index_expansion/temp_query_search_pruning.py).
temporal.label: measured

identity_split.evidence: Splits evidence by speaker role. single-session-user vs single-session-assistant vs single-session-preference. Still one user talking to one assistant. No character vs relationship vs lore.
identity_split.label: measured

silence.evidence: Abstention items (question_id suffix _abs). README says 30 abstention instances are skipped for retrieval metrics because they have no ground-truth location. Abstention is 'do not invent a missing event', not 'do not surface a known fact at a creepy time'.
silence.label: measured

poisoning.evidence: No jailbreak-via-stored-memory or persona-overwrite probes in the question types or README.
poisoning.label: measured

forgetting.evidence: Knowledge-update tests replacing an old fact with a newer one. No user 'forget that' deletion items.
forgetting.label: measured

cost_shape.evidence: Official score is QA correctness via evaluate_qa.py (GPT-4o judge). Scale is a difficulty knob (S vs M vs custom haystack length), not a cost-per-turn meter.
cost_shape.label: measured

local.evidence: MIT code. Data on Hugging Face. evaluate_qa.py defaults to an OpenAI GPT-4o judge. Open-weight readers are supported through a local vLLM OpenAI emulator.
local.label: measured

companion_fit_reason: Models a chat assistant that must extract facts, update them, reason across sessions, and abstain. That is closer to companion user-memory than LoCoMo. It still scores injected-context QA, not character identity, social silence, poisoning, or forget-that.

published_eval.name: LongMemEval
published_eval.claimed_score: Paper abstract. Commercial chat assistants and long-context LLMs show a 30% accuracy drop on memorizing information across sustained interactions. Per-system leaderboard numbers are vendor claims, not this paper.
published_eval.what_it_actually_scores: Chat-assistant QA over timestamped multi-session history. Abilities are information extraction, multi-session reasoning, temporal reasoning, knowledge updates, and abstention. question_type also includes single-session preference and assistant-side recall.

open_unknowns: Exact per-category accuracy table from the PDF was not loaded this session (HTML fetch timed out). Abstract 30% drop is measured from the abs page.
Mem0 blog claims 94.4% overall on LongMemEval. That is a vendor number, not a LongMemEval paper number.
